_README: Task #394 - Marc's required-context declaration. COPY THIS to
config/required_context.json and edit. Until that file exists,
context_coverage abstains and Jasper's behaviour is unchanged.
This says which data points a category of work should have ON FILE for the
record to count as complete. It is a COMPLETENESS CHECKLIST, not a claim
about what is true and not a ranking of sources - a missing field becomes a
named gap that Jasper goes looking for or asks about, never something it
fills in by inference.
Field names must match data_point_definitions.name exactly. The seven
CONFIRMED definitions available today are:
Deadline / mentioned date          (119 values on file)
Dollar amount                      (646)
PR/PO reference number             (297)
Product/service description        (74)
Stakeholder / named contact        (7732)
Subject/topic core                 (1420)
Supplier / external company        (2088)
Categories in live use: contract, other, financial, relationship,
negotiation, rfp-sourcing, onboarding, compliance, performance, savings,
expense. Any category you omit simply keeps abstaining.
The values below are an ILLUSTRATION of the shape, not a recommendation.
Jasper deliberately does not propose what your work requires.
